title: Search Click
description: One row each time a user opens a search result. Rows older than the tymly_searchLogRetentionDays registry key (default 365) are deleted on boot and once a day.

searchLogId.description: The id of the tymly.search_log row for the search the result came from

userId.description: The ID of the user who opened the result

docId.description: The docId of the result opened

docType.description: The docType of the result opened

position.description: The position of the result across all pages (1 is the first result)
